info.name: MediDropBox Patient API Collection
info.description:
Patient-facing API collection for MediDropBox - All APIs that patients can use

**Authentication:**
- Patients use Phone + OTP (last 4 digits of phone number)
- No password required

**Key Features:**
- OTP-based authentication
- Browse hospitals and doctors
- Create bookings with payment
- Manage profile (address, Aadhar, ABHA, emergency contacts)
- View all bookings across all hospitals
- View queue status
- Share bookings with family/friends
- Upload and manage lab reports (XRAY, CT_SCAN, BLOOD_TEST, etc.)
- Grant/revoke permissions for doctors/hospitals to view reports
- Permission (patient side): all requests to me; all given permissions; revoke permission
- Health profile management (height, blood group, gender, date of birth)
- Vitals tracking with full history (weight, blood glucose, blood pressure)
- BMI calculation and reports with inspirational quotes

**Patient Flow:**
1. Register patient (optional - can skip if booking directly)
2. Generate OTP
3. Verify OTP (auto-login, gets JWT token)
4. Browse hospitals and doctors
5. Create booking (with optional payment and data consent)
6. View bookings and queues
7. Manage profile
8. Upload lab reports and manage permissions
9. Create health profile and track vitals
10. Get BMI reports with health insights

**Patient Related Data folder:** Use "Patient Related Data (Self Booking & Profile)" for profile, self booking only (Create Booking, Get My Bookings, Get Booking by ID), queues, and sharing. No update for book-for-friends (only Create Booking for Friend in 5. Bookings).

request.description: Register as a patient. No password required - uses OTP for login. If UNCLAIMED patient exists with same phone (created by hospital), claims it. Otherwise creates new CLAIMED patient.
Generate OTP for phone number. Currently hardcoded: OTP is last 4 digits of phone number. For phone +91-9876543210, OTP is 3210.

Verify OTP and get JWT tokens. If patient doesn't exist, will be created. If UNCLAIMED, will be claimed. OTP is last 4 digits of phone number. Automatically saves accessToken, refreshToken, and globalPatientId to environment.

request.description:
Create a new booking for yourself (PATIENT only). Uses global patient ID from JWT. Queue is created automatically.

**Data Consent:** dataConsent: true copies full data to HospitalPatient; false = basic only.

**Payment:** Optional; can be added later.

**Book for friend:** Omit bookFor* fields for self-booking. For booking on behalf of another person, use "Create Booking (for Friend)" request.

Create a booking on behalf of a friend/family (PATIENT only). You (logged-in user) own the booking; friend gets a Hospital Patient record only (no Global Patient). Friend can access via Share Booking.

**Required for book-for-friend:**
- bookOnBehalfConsent: true (mandatory)
- bookForName, bookForPhone

**Optional:** bookForDateOfBirth, bookForEmail, bookForDescription

**Note:** Do not send bookFor* when booking for yourself.
Get ALL bookings for the current patient across ALL hospitals (cross-hospital query, PATIENT only). Uses globalPatientId from authenticated user.
Get booking details by ID. PATIENT can only view their own bookings. Uses globalPatientId from authenticated user for verification.

item.name: 8. Permission Requests & Grants
List All Requests to Me (Pending & History)

request.description: As patient: see all requests to you (from hospital/doctor for vitals, reports, health). Pending and history. Use requestId to approve or reject.

Approve a permission request (grant access). For REPORTS scope, a report permission is created so the doctor/hospital can view your lab reports. Uses globalPatientId from JWT. (PATIENT only)

**Usage:**
- Use requestId from "List My Permission Requests"
- Only the patient who owns the data can approve

Reject a permission request (deny access). Uses globalPatientId from JWT. (PATIENT only)

**Usage:**
- Use requestId from "List My Permission Requests"
- Only the patient who owns the data can reject

Revoke an approved permission request (removes the granted permission). Works for all scopes (REPORTS, VITALS, HEALTH). Uses globalPatientId from JWT. (PATIENT only)

**Usage:**
- Use requestId from "List All Requests to Me" where status is APPROVED
- This will revoke the granted permission (set isActive=false on the permission)
- Only the patient who owns the data can revoke

As patient: list all permissions you have granted across all scopes (REPORTS, VITALS, HEALTH). Each permission includes scope field. Use permissionId and scope from here to revoke.

**Response includes:**
- All REPORTS permissions (who can view your lab reports)
- All VITALS permissions (who can view your vitals)
- All HEALTH permissions (who can view your health profile)
- Each item has: id, scope, doctorId, hospitalId, isActive, grantedAt, expiresAt, notes

query.description: Permission scope: REPORTS, VITALS, or HEALTH

request.description:
Revoke any granted permission by permission ID and scope. Works for all scopes (REPORTS, VITALS, HEALTH). Use permissionId and scope from "Get All Given Permissions" response. (PATIENT only)

**Usage:**
- Use permissionId from "Get All Given Permissions" response
- Set scope query param: REPORTS, VITALS, or HEALTH
- Example: /permissions/123?scope=REPORTS
- Example: /permissions/456?scope=VITALS
- Example: /permissions/789?scope=HEALTH

item.description:
Unified permission management API for all scopes (REPORTS, VITALS, HEALTH). Patient side only.

**Request Flow:**
1. **List All Requests to Me** – See all requests from hospital/doctor for REPORTS/VITALS/HEALTH (pending and history)
2. **Approve Permission Request** – Grant access (creates permission for the requested scope)
3. **Reject Permission Request** – Deny access (doctor can request again)
4. **Revoke Approved Request** – Revoke an approved request (removes the granted permission)

**Direct Permission Management:**
5. **Get All Given Permissions** – List all permissions you've granted (all scopes: REPORTS, VITALS, HEALTH)
6. **Grant Report Permission (Direct)** – Grant report access directly without request flow (REPORTS only)
7. **Revoke Permission (Any Scope)** – Revoke any permission by ID and scope (REPORTS/VITALS/HEALTH)

**Note:** All permission management is now unified under `/api/v1/patients/permission-requests`. The old `/api/v1/patients/lab-reports/permissions` endpoints have been moved here.

item.name: 10. Health Profile & Vitals

request.description:
Create or update fixed health profile (height, blood group, gender, date of birth). One profile per patient. Updating replaces old values. (PATIENT only)

**Blood Group Values:**
- A_POSITIVE, A_NEGATIVE
- B_POSITIVE, B_NEGATIVE
- AB_POSITIVE, AB_NEGATIVE
- O_POSITIVE, O_NEGATIVE

**Gender Values:**
- MALE, FEMALE, OTHER, PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY

**Height:** In centimeters (50-300 cm)
**Date of Birth:** Format YYYY-MM-DD
Get current authenticated patient's health profile. Returns height, blood group, gender, and date of birth. (PATIENT only)

Create a new vitals record (history-based). At least one vital value is required. Each submission creates a new record (preserves full history). (PATIENT only)

**Fields (all optional, but at least one required):**
- weightKg: Weight in kilograms (10-500 kg)
- bloodGlucoseMgdl: Blood glucose in mg/dL (20-600 mg/dL)
- bloodPressureSystolic: Systolic BP (50-250)
- bloodPressureDiastolic: Diastolic BP (30-150)
- recordedAt: Timestamp (optional, defaults to now)
- notes: Optional notes about this entry

**Note:** Automatically saves vitalsRecordId to environment for update/delete operations.

Update a specific vitals entry. Only the owner (patient) can update their records. Only provided fields will be updated (partial update). (PATIENT only)

**Usage:**
- Use vitalsRecordId from "Create Vitals Record" response or "Get Vitals History"
- Only include fields you want to update
- All fields are optional

Delete a specific vitals entry. Only the owner (patient) can delete their records. (PATIENT only)

**Usage:**
- Use vitalsRecordId from "Create Vitals Record" response or "Get Vitals History"
- This will permanently delete the record

Get the most recent value for each vital (weight, glucose, blood pressure). Includes BMI calculation if height and weight are available. (PATIENT only)

**Response includes:**
- Latest weight with date
- Latest blood glucose with date
- Latest blood pressure (systolic/diastolic) with date
- BMI (if height and weight available)
- BMI category and inspirational quote
- Safety disclaimer

Get full vitals history with optional filters by date range and/or vital type. (PATIENT only)

**Request Body (all optional):**
- startDate: Filter from date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- endDate: Filter to date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- vitalType: Filter by type - WEIGHT, BLOOD_GLUCOSE, BLOOD_PRESSURE, or ALL (default)

**Note:** If request body is empty or not provided, returns all vitals records ordered by date (newest first)

Get comprehensive BMI report with calculation, category, description, inspirational quote, and health recommendations. BMI is calculated dynamically using latest weight and stored height. (PATIENT only)

**Response includes:**
- BMI value (calculated)
- BMI category (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese)
- BMI description
- Inspirational quote (randomized per category)
- Health recommendations
- Height and weight used for calculation
- Weight recorded date
- Safety disclaimer

**Requirements:**
- Health profile must exist with height
- At least one weight record must exist

**BMI Categories:**
- Underweight: BMI < 18.5
- Normal: 18.5 ≤ BMI < 25
- Overweight: 25 ≤ BMI < 30
- Obese: BMI ≥ 30

item.description:
Manage health profile (fixed values) and vitals records (history-based). Track weight, blood glucose, blood pressure with full history. Get BMI reports with inspirational quotes.

**Health Profile (Fixed):**
- One profile per patient
- Fields: Height, Blood Group, Gender, Date of Birth
- Updating replaces old values

**Vitals Records (History):**
- Multiple records preserved
- Fields: Weight, Blood Glucose, Blood Pressure
- At least one vital required per record
- Full history maintained
- Can update or delete individual records

**BMI Calculation:**
- Calculated dynamically (not stored)
- Uses latest weight + stored height
- Includes category, quote, and recommendations

**Safety:**
- All data is patient-entered
- For tracking purposes only
- Not a substitute for medical advice
